title: Claim
description: A reviewed claim as produced by the review engine and as referenced by StatusArtifact.claims. kind is the explicit final classification; state defaults to active and governs contradiction and health participation (only active claims count); subject/value pair the typed contradiction key; mitigation is required on active risks; source references are always canonical structured SourceRef objects.

id.description: Stable claim identifier within the artifact.

kind.description: Explicit final classification. The engine never infers kind from wording.

state.description: Lifecycle state. Only active claims participate in contradictions and program health; superseded and historical claims are reported but never judged.

subject.description: Stable subject key used for typed contradiction checks. Active contradiction checks require both subject and value.

value.description: Scalar typed value. Objects, arrays, and null are rejected; contradictions compare typed values so 1 and "1" remain distinct.

owner.description: Human or team accountable for the claim.

due_at.description: Commitment date. Active blockers require owner and due_at.

mitigation.description: Active risks require owner and mitigation.

source_refs.description: Canonical structured references. The engine reports an empty array as a blocking issue.
